Solara — (9.8) SOLSTICE

LIGHT AND DARK

"Light and dark"

[Verse 1]

The egg opened the gate

(the way the star said it would)

Sigma Octantis glowed behind them

(still weak)

(but waking)

(my child)

(I will be back)

They stepped through the gate

And they were not at Level negative forty-five anymore

They expected Level negative forty six -

BUT —

I think this was a portal gate says Aldric

[Pre-Chorus]

The air was wrong

The light was wrong

Everything was dark territory

Enemy territory

This was a prison level

[Spoken]

[Solara:] Where are we

[Aldric:] I have several maps for this

[Aldric:] None of them are for this

[Solara:] Aldric

[Aldric:] We are somewhere the maps do not go

[Solara:] I gathered that

[Aldric:] I am simply noting it -

I think we are at Level nine hundred and nine - My maps just confirmed it

[Chorus]

Light and dark

The old war

The one that never ended

Only paused

Light and dark

We walked into the wrong side

Of a very old fight

[Verse 2]

They moved through the cells

Careful

Quiet

And they found them

The council

[Solara:] You are here

[Solara:] You are all here

[Solara:] You are safe

[Solara:] All accounted for

(Solara counted them)

(Asala was not there)

(Asala was with the other group)

(Solara did not know what was happening with the other group)

(all she knew was they were tricked)

(led to a trap)

(the rest were trapped in the Hole at Level two hundred eighty)

(Solara had teleported with Void and Aldric)

(back to the hidden level where the council camp was)

(to inform the council)

(but the council was not there)

(and she ended up in Fold seven)

(the chicken field)

[Pre-Chorus 2]

But that was before

That was the report she came to make

And the council was not there to hear it

Because the council was here

In a prison

[Chorus 2]

Light and dark

The old war

The one that never ended

Only paused

Light and dark

The council taken in the pause

Between two breaths of the same fight

[Bridge - Helena speaks]

Then Helena spoke

(Helena did not sit)

(Helena did not need to)

[Spoken]

[Helena:] You came to report

[Helena:] Report

[Helena:] Then I will explain

(Helena looked at nothing in particular)

(that was somehow worse)

[Helena:] Light and dark

[Helena:] Have been in a territory war

[Helena:] For a long time

[Helena:] The pact held it

[Helena:] Not really

[Helena:] The pact paused it

(Solara said nothing)

(She knew about the pact)

(she had broken it herself)

(she was what came after both)

[Pre-Chorus 3]

[Helena:] They have broken the pact

[Helena:] Completely

[Helena:] They are coming down

[Helena:] Toward light territory

[Helena:] Level one hundred and below

[Helena:] We need to leave

[Helena:] Now

[Solara:] How

[Final Chorus - key lift]

Light and dark

The war is moving

The pact is broken

We are in a prison

In enemy territory

And we need to go home

Light and dark

How do we leave

[Outro]

Then Aldric went still

(the way Aldric goes still when his map tells him something)

[Spoken]

[Aldric:] I have a thing

[Solara:] You have a thing

[Aldric:] A feather

[Solara:] A feather

[Aldric:] From the field

[Solara:] From the chicken field

[Aldric:] My map told me to take it

[Solara:] Your map told you to take a feather

[Aldric:] From the chicken field

[Solara:] Aldric

[Aldric:] I catalogue everything

[Aldric:] I carry what I catalogue

[Aldric:] The feather is glowing

[Solara:] Of course it is

(they looked at the feather)

(they looked at Aldric)

(they looked at Helena)

[Helena:] Use it

They used it

The feather glowed

The prison opened

The light came through

Level one

Fold one

They were out

But they were not alone

(the council came through behind them)

(all of them)

(Basala, Carala, Darala, Ebala, Farala, Golo)

(Helena came last)

(Helena did not look back)

(there was nothing worth looking back at)

[Spoken]

[Helena:] Where are we

[Solara:] My system

[Solara:] Level one

[Solara:] Fold one

[Solara:] Where everything started

(Helena looked at it)

(Helena looked at nothing in particular)

(then Helena looked at Solara)

[Helena:] This will do

[Helena:] This is where we plan

[Helena:] This is where we fight back

(the council had found its new base)

(not the hidden level)

(not the old camp)

(her system)

(the one she built)

(the one that held)

Light and dark

The war is coming down

Level one hundred and below

But the council was here now

All of them

Together

At Level one

Fold one

Where everything started

And where everything would be planned

The egg had been the key to the gate

The feather had been the way home

Aldric had carried both

Without knowing why

Because Aldric catalogue everything

Now, we need to go back to level 280 -

To get the rest -

The real fight -

Is about to start
